title: Australian Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
description: A moist and flavorful cake made with pineapple rings and a hint of exotic spices. Perfect for a sweet snack or dessert.
instructions: Grease a 10-inch tube pan or Bundt pan.
In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and yeast.
In a large bowl, whisk together butter, eggs, and pineapple juice.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined.
Gently fold in the pineapple rings.
Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 40-45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from the oven and let cool in the pan for 10 minutes.
Transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
If using pecans, sprinkle on top of the cake before serving.
